stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Michael Leary is the benchmark side this week on 38 pts, everyone else is officially building for next year.

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 18 coming home vs 11 out

stories.title: Hot Hole
stories.detail: gave up 18 threes today - the pin was there for the taking

stories.title: The Graveyard
stories.detail: 10 wipes handed out - where cards go to die

stories.title: Golden Hole
stories.detail: the field's happy place - averaged 2.4 points

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 155 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: In the Hunt
stories.detail: 2nd - 2 off the pace

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Peter Hamblin from Young GC has had a crack at our layout and lived to tell the tale.

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 9 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Short-Hole Sniper
stories.detail: 2 threes on the par 3s - dialled in with the irons

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.title: Reachable Feeling
stories.detail: 2 of the par 5s gave up 3-pointers - length is a weapon

stories.title: Giveth and Taketh Away
stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 16, 17 & 18

stories.title: The Metronome
stories.detail: 7 holes in a row at 2 points or better - tick, tick, tick

stories.title: Nothing But Ones
stories.detail: 7 1-pointers, zero wipes - zero wipes is something to hang your hat on

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: Under the Radar
stories.detail: 4 3-pointers+ through the round - not flashy, just effective

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 17 & 18 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 19 on the front, 12 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: Front-Runner
stories.detail: Front nine 19, back nine 12 - the tank hit empty

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 4 twos on holes 15-18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 3 twos in a row on holes 16, 17 & 18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Committed to the One-Pointer
stories.detail: 9 1-pointers - every hole is a 1-pointer and that is the plan

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 17 & 18 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Doug Sutton slipped 1st to 10th, still finals bound with a bit of polish on the short game.

stories.title: In the Wet
stories.detail: 4.2 soaked the lot of them and the scoreboard has the proof.

comingLast.roast: the 4.2 mm of rain did him no favours - 22 and the blue balls prove it
in on a 3-point buffer - watching the door like everyone else
safe-ish by 4 - the blue balls have come back from further
in on 4 above the drop - his shout if he survives, tradition says
